children: Spain has mandated banks for a new syndicated 20-year green government bond maturing on July 30, 2047, a lead manager memo seen by Reuters said on Monday.
The deal is expected to raise €4 billion ($4.65 billion) and will be launched in the near future, subject to market conditions, the memo said.
Barclays, BBVA, Credit Agricole CIB, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and Santander have been selected as lead managers.
Other primary dealers in Spain's government bond market will be invited to join the syndication.
Proceeds will be used in line with Spain's updated Green Bond Framework, the memo said.
